test_name: Stun bar not updating on junkdog/jungledog variants - 1cb134ce-a9a8-48cd-a7ae-ec54203bf21f
summary: Traced the SP stun pipeline end-to-end: DamageHandler.ConsumeGenericDamage -> root GameEntity.AddStunDamage (stunDamage/stunBufferSize on the root BaseEnemyEntity, buffer from BaseEnemyEntity.stunBuffer in Awake) -> BotUISpawner spawns pooled 'Bot UI' -> BotHealthBar.Setup resolves _stunComponent via GetComponentInParent<IStunComponent> (falls back to root) and sets the bar max once -> BotHealthBar.UpdateStun pushes stunDamage to HealthBarUI each LateUpdate. I compared the working prefabs (Junkdog, Junkdog - Bloodhound, JungleDog) with every affected variant (Spiked, Armored, Armored-Left/Right, Turbo, Turbo Spiked, Turbo Armored in both families). stunBuffer, the BotUISpawner placement and the entity parent chain are the same everywhere. The only override every broken variant shares that the working ones lack is CreatureID.difficulty/prefabName, and in SP code nothing on the stun or UI path reads those. The archetype.boundComponents overrides point at a component no longer in the base, so they are stale data. No root cause was established from code or saved data, so no code was changed. A plausible-looking guess would cost a reviewer more than this report.
instructions:
Bug: for certain singleplayer enemies, the stun bar UI/value does not visibly update as the enemy takes hits, even though after enough hits the enemy does eventually become stunned. This affects:
1. All junkdog enemy variants EXCEPT the base junkdog and the bloodhound junkdog (those two work correctly).
2. All jungledog enemy variants EXCEPT the normal/base jungledog (that one works correctly).

So the stun mechanic itself is functioning (enough hits still trigger a stun), but the stun bar value/display used to show progress toward stun is broken for these specific enemy variants. Since the base/normal versions of each enemy type work fine, compare how stun bar state is tracked, updated, and read for the working base enemies versus the affected variant subclasses/prefabs/configs to find where the variants diverge (e.g. overridden stats, missing component references, different initialization path, variant-specific data not wired up, etc.).

Investigate the enemy stun bar system end-to-end: where stun progress is incremented on taking a hit, where that value is stored per-enemy instance, and where the UI reads it to render the bar. Find the root cause of why the affected junkdog and jungledog variants don't update/display this value correctly, and fix it so the stun bar accurately reflects stun progress for every listed variant, consistent with the working base/bloodhound versions. Verify the fix across all affected variants, not just one, since the issue spans multiple enemy subtypes in two different enemy families.

Do not use /conversations or any other tool that gives access to previous fixes/changes made by other people in this repo — investigate and fix this independently using only the current state of the codebase.
not_done: Root cause not identified statically. Next step: in Play mode, spawn Junkdog next to Turbo Junkdog / Junkdog - Spiked. For each, sample per frame across a hit: BotHealthBar._stunComponent (is it the root?), the root's stunDamage/stunBufferSize, and the stun HealthBarUI _maxHealth/_currentHealth. That shows whether the hit path or the UI diverges.
